projectDescription: AIWA is an AI product team platform that plans, builds, deploys, and continuously evolves websites, SaaS apps, CRMs, and full-stack applications from plain English descriptions.
keyFeatures: Agentic workflow engine: Plan → Architect → Build → Test → Evolve
Project Brain™ — persistent AI memory across the full product lifecycle
Full-stack generation (frontend, backend, database, auth) from a prompt
One-click deploy to live URL with custom domain, SSL, and CDN
Mobile app export — signed APK (Android) and IPA (iOS) from a web app
Invisible managed Postgres backend with auth and storage, zero config
Built-in integrations: Stripe, Resend, Cloudinary, Google, GitHub, Twilio
AI SEO Agent — continuous ranking monitoring and automated fixes
AI CRO Agent — conversion monitoring and onboarding optimization
AI Revenue Agent — MRR signals, churn risk, and upgrade opportunities
AI Testing Agent — automated browser testing before every deployment
Multi-model AI engine: Claude Opus/Sonnet, GPT-4o, Gemini 2.5 Pro
Team collaboration with role-based access and client review portals
publicApiSurface: Custom domain connection via Project Hub
